title: Carathéodory Number in Cycle Convexity
summary: Let $G$ be a graph and $S \subseteq V(G)$. In the cycle convexity, we say that $S$ is \textit{cycle convex} if for any $u\in V(G)\setminus S$, the induced subgraph of $S\cup\{u\}$ contains no cycle that includes $u$. The \textit{cycle convex hull} of $S$, denoted by $\hullc (S)$, is the smallest cycle convex set containing $S$.
